QuestInfo.name: Keol's Order #5
QuestInfo.0: Keol, the pompous working partner of Moren who is as irritable as they come in all of Maple, is giving me a new work request. Better go see what it is.
QuestInfo.1: Moren's coworker Keol received a request from Valen of Florina Beach for a pair of shoes. A pair of footwear on the sandy beach... it probably should be light yet sturdy...!\n\n#i4001178# #t4001178# #b#c4001178# / 5
QuestInfo.2: Moren's coworker Keol received a request from Valen of Florina Beach for a pair of beach sandals, and asked me to do it for him. I tried my best, but of course, Keol believes it's the worst thing in the world.

0.0: Are you... friends with this Valen fellow? I just received a request from him, and he wanted you to make it. I can tell he doesn't really care for quality; otherwise he wouldn't name you as the person to make the item. Anyway, since it's a direct request to you, I'm sure you'll accept this. Right?

yes.0: Here's the purchase order. It's much smaller than I thought. It's only #b5 pairs of #t4001178#s#k. Remember that he'll be wearing those at the sandy beach, which means the sandals have to be light, comfortable, yet durable as well. Can you imagine walking around in the sand wearing heavy, uncomfortable shoes?

no.0: I thought you didn't have any skills. Now I realize you don't even have integrity. Here's the guy that specifically asked you to make the items for him, and you said no. I knew I had an eye for people. I knew you were no good from day one. Thanks for clarifying that point.

1.0: You were able to meet the deadline. I JUST got off the phone from Valen wondering when he'd receive his shipment. It's an urgent request, so I better overnight this.

item.0: Are you sure you read the purchase order? When will #b#t4001178##k be completed? You know you don't have much time, right?

lost.0: This is preposterous. Unbelievable. How can you not even take care of the purchase order I gave you? What was Moren thinking? Seriously, un-be-lieeevable.
